Prices for the stay of Nov 2 to 4, 2026, as listed on September 28, 2026.

18 Madrid hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 28, 2026 for Nov 2 to Nov 4, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Madrid hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 Madrid hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Evendo at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Hostelworld at 1, Traveluro at 1 and Trip.com at 1. These are the Madrid rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 16 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Vio.com at 3, Etrip.net at 2, Evendo at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Agoda at 1, goseek.com at 1, Hostelworld at 1 and 3 other sites at 3 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 2, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Madrid hotels

At the 15 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($19 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at Futurotel Space Spa Madrid Center to 10% at 60 BALCONIES ICONIC. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
